title: Nelson B NDE 22275
content: Drank thirty plus cups of coffee on empty stomach from 7 am to 7 pm. While driving home, esophagus ruptured dumping coffee into chest cavity. Lungs collapsed. Mitral valve pushed backward and heart stopped. I was hovering about thirty feet into air when two guys in baseball uniforms pulled over and took me out of car and placed me in the back of their pickup truck. One of them gave me CPR while the other one drove to hospital. Hospital attendants came out to truck and put me on gurney. As the gurney went into the emergency room, my perspective was still about thirty feet above. I was one or two floors above my body looking down on the emergency room staff trying to resuscitate me. I recall all instructions of the doctor, color of nurses' hair, names of the people who were given instructions. They used the paddles before they figured out I had coffee in my chest. They made two incisions and stuck tubes in my chest. Coffee was draining out onto the floor. Additional procedures were performed before the paddles restarted my heart. When this happened, my recollection ends. Use this information wisely. A lady at my office was reading a book called ‘The Experience of Dying’. A couple of months after my OBE, she and I talked about it. She committed suicide days later.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Hovering about thirty feet in the air; later one or two floors above his body looking down on ER staff.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two guys in baseball uniforms pulled over, took him out of the car, put him in their pickup; one gave CPR while the other drove to the hospital.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Esophagus ruptured after drinking 30+ cups of coffee on an empty stomach; coffee dumped into chest cavity, lungs collapsed; mitral valve pushed backward and heart stopped.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed rescue/transport and ER resuscitation efforts from an elevated perspective.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with elevated vantage during rescue and resuscitation; no tunnel/light/realm described; recollection ends when heart restarted.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two guys in baseball uniforms stopped, removed him from the car, and transported him in a pickup truck while he was already hovering above; detailed observation of medical procedures including coffee draining onto the ER floor.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was hovering about thirty feet into air…”; “I was one or two floors above my body looking down on the emergency room staff trying to resuscitate me.”; “Coffee was draining out onto the floor.”; “Use this information wisely.”
